clue.text: For Titanic a disaster any video game might reproduce

indicators.note: to reproduce here is to make the letters over again in a new order, so the phrase is rearranged

explanation.surface: A video game recreating the sinking of the Titanic is mooted.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is wry: the Titanic sank on its first ever crossing, so for that ship this event was the disaster.
explanation.definitionFit: The liner struck an iceberg on its first ever trip in 1912, so its inaugural crossing was the catastrophe.

clue.text: End up protecting one burning group of civilians when fighting

one is the Roman numeral I
burning means lit

explanation.surface: Someone is told to finish by guarding a person on fire, among civilian fighters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' gives MIA, and 'protecting' places the inner pieces just after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A citizen army raised from ordinary people to fight in an emergency is exactly this kind of force.

clue.text: Jumbo I set mainly impresses married guys

explanation.definitionFit: Jumbo as an adjective means enormous, the size of an elephant, a synonym.

clue.text: Oil producers lie and cut pay anyhow

clue.text: Volume unnamed French writer has penned shows spirit

clue.text: Ill-bred son pulled up twice by husband

clue.text: Acrimony over having drug aboard ship
